verses.text: “Son of man, take up a lamentation for Pharaoh king of Egypt, and say to him: ‘To a young lion of the nations you may be compared, and you [are] like the monster in the seas. You burst forth in your rivers and you stir up the waters with your feet, and you muddy their rivers.’
